messages:
maria: FYI opening support case with GCP for APAC onboarding — we need additional A100 quota + more external NAT ports. target week: next sprint (Mon)
ashok: Thanks — is this for prod or staging? also need to know project id and whether it's a new billing account
maria: Prod. Project: redwood-apac-prod. Billing is already set up. primary ask: +8 A100 (on-demand) in asia-southeast1, and increase forwarding rules / external IP quota by +60 for the cluster LB and nat pools
kai: tagging network limits — forwarding rules are the usual bottleneck in that region. have you checked current quotas? `gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --project=redwood-apac-prod --format=json | jq .quotas`
maria: I ran a quick check — GPUs at 2/8, forwarding rules 12/20 currently. but we need temporary burst to 80 forwarding rules for migration. created case, waiting on escalation.
cloud-support-bot: GCP Support case created: Case ID 9876543210. Assigned engineer: Ananya S. Initial response expected within 24h. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/9876543210
selene: added the billing contact and owner links on the case. @ashok can you add the org-level justification doc (cost + SLA) so we can ask for TAM involvement?
ashok: doing that now. assigning the doc to the case.
cloud-support-bot: Update: Engineer Ananya responded — requested vCPU quota checks and confirmation that this is not a quota increase for GPUs only, but also for related resources (vCPUs, GPUs, IPs).
maria: Confirmed — we need vCPU +64 (for the GPU nodes), GPUs +8, external IPs +60. Also we'll use preemptible for burst; please note that we still need dedicated on-demand for steady workers.
kai: note that GCP sometimes ties A100 availability to zones; we should ask for zone affinity (asia-southeast1-a/b) and quota assigned per-zone if possible.
maria: added that to the case note.
sre-oncall: If GCP pushes back on forwarding rules, we can temporarily use internal LB + proxy NAT to reduce external IP needs. But that adds complexity.
ashok: Also opened an AWS parallel case for eu-west2 in case we need cross-cloud fallback: AWS Case 5557766. not urgent but want options.
selene: GCP engineer asked for expected timeline and start-up date — replied: need capacity by 2026-04-06 for canary. Marked as high priority and requested TAM escalation.
cloud-support-bot: GCP Support update (2026-03-20 09:12 UTC): Case 9876543210: Engineer escalated to TAM team. Estimated resolution 72h.
maria: Thanks. any cost implications we should pre-approve? preemptible + on-demand mix should keep monthly delta < $15k — finance ok with provisional spend.
kai: reminder: when quotas are granted, double-check `gcloud compute project-info describe` and the per-zone values. If they only increase global GPUs but not zone, we may still be blocked.
ashok: Will post a 👀 when quota shows up. Also asked Ananya to provide an internal case escalation token so we can push via TAM if needed.
cloud-support-bot: GCP Support update (2026-03-21 14:45 UTC): Case 9876543210: Quotas provisionally increased. GPUs: +8 (global), vCPUs: +64, External IPs: +60. Zone affinity pending. Pending your confirmation to finalize.
maria: Confirmed receipt. Kai — can you validate availability in asia-southeast1-a/b and report back? If they can't assign zone affinity, we'll ask for project-level reservations.
kai: Running a zone availability query now, will post results in thread.
selene: Once validated, I'll schedule the cluster spin-up and flag infra runbook changes for NAT handling.
sre-oncall: If anything blocks, I'll start the fallbacks documented in infra/runbooks/cloud-fallback.
maria: Perfect. Thanks everyone. Please keep updates here and paste supporting case links. :thumbsup:
cloud-support-bot: Final update (2026-03-22 18:02 UTC): Case 9876543210 closed by GCP Support after quota assignment. Reference: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/9876543210#resolution
maria: Closing the loop — quotas now visible. spinning up canary nodes tomorrow morning. I'll open a brief post-mortem if we hit any hiccups.
ashok: Awesome, thanks team :tada:
kai: Verified GPUs available in asia-southeast1-a and -b. forwarding rules quota increased as well. all green from my side.
selene: Scheduling cluster rollout. will post start time.
maria: End of thread.
